QuestInfo.name: Night Walker Knighthood Exam
QuestInfo.0: According to #p1101002#, you can take the Knighthood Exam from Chief Knight of Darkness #b#p1101006##k. Go to Ereve and meet #p1101006#.
QuestInfo.1: The Knighthood Exam has begun. It's quite simple. Go to #bThe 2nd Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest, and defeat the monster in it.\r\n#b(If you fail, forfeit the quest and start it again.)
QuestInfo.2: You have completed the Knighthood Exam. You are no longer a Knight-in-Training, but a full-fledged official knight. Be the dark shadow of the Cygnus Knights, untainted by evil.

default.0: The shadows whisper. You have not passed the exam at the #bSecond Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest. You won't be worthy until you do.

0.0: I have been keeping tabs on your progress, from deep within the shadows. You are ready for your Knighthood Exam. Will you take it now?
0.1: Go to the #bSecond Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest. Defeat 30 Tiguru of Exam monsters, then return to #p1101007#.
0.2: Once your task is done, I will recognize you as a knight. May the shadows cloak you and keep you safe.\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to #m130020000# automatically.)#k#n

no.0: The shadows shift, but nothing has changed. Speak to me when you are ready.
